AFWD.justification: Forward morphism transforms each fork-depth ratio through twice the arctangent function into a Majorana CP phase value.

CLINK.justification: Composition links the evaluation of first and third arms and the fixation step into the ordered sequence that precedes FFUSE.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: coexistence of both Majorana phase candidates
ENGAGR.justification: Both affirmed fork-depth phases exist simultaneously as derived Majorana candidates, held without resolution before permanent writing.

EVALF.justification: The false branch marks the second fork-depth phase as not a Majorana CP phase, excluding it from fixation.

EVALT.chosen_element: affirmative selection of first and third arms
EVALT.justification: The true branch anchors the arms indexed first and third, confirming their role as Majorana CP phases.

FFUSE.justification: Multiplication merges the three fork-depth phases back into the original SIC flavor partition, satisfying FFUSE(FSPLIT(x))=x.

FSPLIT.justification: The partition co-multiplies into three fork-depth phases (first, second, third) as distinct arms for phase extraction.

IFIX.justification: ROM fixation irreversibly appends the two phase values to the neutrino mass eigenstate phase record.

IMSCRIB.justification: Each fork-depth phase recognizes itself as a distinct element of the SIC partition, neutral with respect to CP phase assignment.

TANCH.chosen_element: sealed neutrino mass eigenstate phase lattice
TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor closes the system after the two Majorana CP phases are permanently written, containing the partition and all derived morphisms.

VINIT.justification: Before the SIC flavor partition is defined, no fork-depth phases or CP phases exist; the system is an uninitialized void of flavor eigenstates.
